I am a woman with a small maize plot near Mwanza. I do not have much money for chemical fertilizer, and the shop prices have been high, so I will only put a little manure from my goats and chickens on the soil. I keep seeds from last harvest because buying hybrid seed every year is too costly for me, and the rains here are usually enough so I do not irrigate. My husband and children help me in the field, and when it is time to weed and harvest I will call one or two neighbors to help for a few days.
